changes: After an update, a small card appears in the corner of Studio once, lists what changed, and closes when you tell it to.
Closing that card clears the red 1 on the toolbar icon, the same as opening the popup does.
A new "Update notice on Studio" switch in the popup turns the card off; the badge on the icon still appears either way.
The popup now has a "What's new" section listing what changed in each update you have not read yet, with earlier versions tucked behind a link.
A small red 1 appears on the toolbar icon after an update, and clears the moment you open the popup.
Nothing opens on its own: no tab, no notification, no page.
Every bar in the latest-video ranking now moves as figures come in, not only the newest video's.
Charts that mark every few minutes rise steadily instead of jumping once an hour.
When a query fails, the last real figures are shown for up to fifteen minutes rather than leaving the number raw.
Failed queries are retried quietly in the background so the next page load finds them answered.
The latest-video card's arrow and typical band are now judged from engaged views rather than raw ones.
The dashboard's top-content list is no longer converted twice, which had replaced right figures with wrong ones.
The Audience tab is converted: age and gender, top geographies, subtitle languages and interests.
Tables split two ways, such as age against gender, are converted.
Cards with All, Videos, Shorts and Live tabs show each tab's own figures instead of the whole channel's.
The latest-video ranking ("6 of 10") is rebuilt from engaged views and reordered to match.
